cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Need Your Blessing
cards.instruction: Get approval from someone whose opinion still carries emotional weight, even when permission is unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Mum, we signed the lease. Say it's good news before I open the wine. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't need my permission to move in with Sam.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I know. I still want my mother to be pleased.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm pleased for you. I'm still getting used to Sam.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you toast both of us? I want to remember you welcoming our home, not just tolerating my address.
